dataset.name: nyc-yellow-taxi
dataset.description: NYC yellow taxi trips 2025-07 → 2026-06 · 263 pickup zones · New York wall-clock times

scenarios.name: Hand-written SQL
scenarios.description: The obvious analyst query: GROUP BY pickup zone and date_trunc('week') on the logged wall-clock time.

scenarios.name: Cold · raw fetch
scenarios.description: Empty cache, no pushdown: every trip is read into Meridian, converted from New York time, then bucketed.

scenarios.name: Cold · pushdown
scenarios.description: Empty cache, New York DST conversion and weekly bucketing both done inside DuckDB.

scenarios.name: Warm · cached
scenarios.description: The identical report again: served from Meridian's cache.

scenarios.name: Warm · +1 zone
scenarios.description: The cached report plus one more pickup zone: only the newcomer is fetched.

scenarios.name: Warm · 1 zone changed
scenarios.description: A write invalidates one zone; the next run refetches just that zone.

scenarios.name: Cold · 28-day rolling mean
scenarios.description: Daily trips per zone pushed down (New York days), then a 28-day rolling mean in the engine.
